registryBasis: Chandanaish has a local Upazila Land Office and Sub-Registrar Office published on Bangladesh’s official National Portal. The municipal portal publishes ward-map downloads, while the official national Mauza and Plot Based Digital Land Zoning site describes georeferenced mouza sheets and plot-based planning. These sources establish local land-administration/cartography functions, but no public parcel-vector schema or full geometry was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

officialSources.observation: Official Upazila Land Office page on Bangladesh’s National Portal; identifies the locality’s land-administration office and links government land services.
Official local Sub-Registrar service page lists NOC, search/inspection, certified-copy, and deed-registration procedures; no case or record query used.
Official Chandanaish Pourashava site links ward-map PDFs; these are static municipal maps, not a published parcel vector schema.

Official national project says mouza map sheets are digitized/georeferenced for land-use zoning and shows administrative and plot selectors. No selectors were submitted, and the project description does not expose a parcel feature service.
